title: Eval Launchpad for Catalog & Tenant Version Promotions
creator: Aisha Patel
description:
Create an automated "Eval Launchpad" service that triggers targeted evaluation runs whenever a model version is promoted or a customer pins a model. This ticket scopes the product surface, acceptance criteria, and rollout plan. Goals: (1) Reduce time-to-detect quality regressions after version promotions; (2) Prioritize tenant-scoped probes for high-traffic customers to limit false positives and cost; (3) Integrate with existing eval runner and the catalog event bus; (4) Provide operator-visible artifacts (sampled diffs, dashboards, and a rollback recommendation).

Scope: catalog promotions (global) and tenant pin events (customer-locked). The launchpad should support: priority profiles, budget caps, canary sampling, fast smoke vs. full regression suites, and webhooks/notifications for downstream systems.

Out of scope: complex human-in-the-loop adjudication flows, billing integration for tenant chargebacks (follow-up ticket), and new model evaluation metrics beyond what the eval runner supports today.
acceptance_criteria: Launchpad subscribes to catalog and tenant pin events from the event bus and enqueues eval jobs within 30s of event arrival
Priority policy: high-priority tenants get at least one fast smoke eval within 5 minutes; default tenants get sampled smoke within 30 minutes
Budget guard prevents >$X/day spend per tenant and emits a throttled warning event
Results surface: a synthetic-diff artifact + summary metrics posted to eval-dashboard and a webhook to customer org if customer pinned
Integration tests exercise catalog promotion -> light smoke -> fail/fallback logic and are green in CI
Operator playbook in Confluence with rollback triggers and who-to-call links exists and is reviewed
work_items: Define priority profiles and sampling rules with SRE and Growth (doc: https://confluence.redwood.ai/display/EVAL/Priority+Profiles)
Add event subscriber and durable queueing to eval-orchestrator (ENG changes)
Implement launchpad controller that maps events to eval job templates (smoke/light/full)
Expose per-tenant budget cap config and a global safety throttle
Wire results posting to eval-dashboard and add a webhook sink for customer-facing alerts
Create CI integration tests and a staging canary run for the launchpad
Write operator playbook and runbook for false positive investigations

notes: Trade-off: aggressive sampling gives faster detection but increases costs. Default policy errs on lower cost and higher sensitivity for top-tier tenants.
We reuse eval runner and existing metrics schema to reduce scope. If later we need richer metrics we'll add a bridging adapter.
Failure modes considered: event bus downtime, eval runner OOM, or noisy tenant leading to false positives. Mitigations: durable queueing, budget cap, and diff aggregation thresholds.
